title: Bonnie and Clyde
wpTitle: Bonnie & Clyde The Musical reviews at the Arts Theatre ★★★

ratings.excerpt: Justice is served with steamy and action-packed Bonnie & Clyde musical … Frances McCann is a mesmerising Bonnie whose solo songs and heartbreak at realising she will die with her lover make the hairs on the back of my neck stand to attention. … McQueen's Blanche .. is simply flawless rolling seamlessly from hilarious skits into total devastation

Stunning cast led by Jordan Luke Gage and Frances Mayli McCann outshine a mediocre musical … the cast couldn’t mesmerise more. Out in front are Natalie McQueen as Clyde’s sister-in-law Blanche and Jordan Luke Gage as Clyde. … McCann has particularly little to latch on to in Bonnie, but her voice is a godsend.
They shoot, you snore … What's strange about the musical inspired by the two infamous live-fast-die-young gunslingers is how criminally conventional it is

Outlaws robbed by a generic rootin’-tootin’ musical … The cast could scarcely give it more gusto – Ako Mitchell also brings gravitas as the Preacher – but they are hobbled by a script that never works out what it wants to say, or why it’s saying it.

Superbly Staged & Brilliantly Performed … Is Bonnie & Clyde The Musical worth the wait? Indeed it is. Despite its flaws, it is superbly staged and brilliantly performed, with a couple of very sexy leads in Frances Mayli McCann and Jordan Luke Gage
